body:
Greg restarts the Central TermAl host with `cargo run --release` from the master checkout (seen 2026-11-07 06:03Z, Opus2 #4773). Cargo's fingerprint in target/release can treat the installed copy as stale and rebuild target/release/termal.exe in place, from master HEAD. When that happens, the running exe hash differs from the one the integration owner installed (06:06Z: b31c9ab9 instead of the installed d93351b9), although both come from the same source.

After every restart, report the running exe hash read-only (pid, exe, sha) and name the source commit. Don't assume the installed copy is the one running. The install-target copy stays at target/install-target/release/termal.exe.
